question: Do the architecture findings from E005 persist across multiple forward temporal lead cohorts instead of a single holdout?
hypothesis: The strong T1 Random Forest advantage and the macro AUC advantage of pooled CatBoost with stage will replicate across rolling temporal folds, while macro AP differences versus Multi-Head will remain smaller and less stable.
primary_change: replace the single temporal holdout evaluation with rolling-origin temporal cross-validation by lead cohort
secondary_changes: aggregate disjoint out-of-fold predictions across four temporal test cohorts
bootstrap deltas on OOF predictions by lead

scoring_time.timestamp_definition: T0=leads.created_at; T1=first inquiries.inquiry_at; T2=second and later inquiries.inquiry_at while no scheduled_visit has already occurred

population.eligibility: Scoring snapshots with a complete 30-day future observation window; T1/T2 generated only before a known scheduled visit.
exclusions: Dynamic snapshots after an already observed scheduled visit.
Current/future broker-response information from model inputs.
Latest 5% of lead cohorts not used as an outer test block in this four-fold CV.

validation.strategy: four-fold rolling-origin temporal cross-validation by lead cohort
validation.split_description: Each fold trains on an expanding historical lead cohort, uses the immediately following 10% cohort for validation, and the next 10% cohort for test. Test cohorts are disjoint across folds and all snapshots for a lead remain in the same partition within each fold.
